class.name: FSGodotNamespace
class.brief_description: The [code]godot[/code] namespace object exposed to FoundryScript.
class.description: Backs the [code]godot[/code] global in FoundryScript. It is a singleton you do not construct; access its members through [code]godot.[/code], for example [code]godot.reflection.get_methods(...)[/code]. Currently it exposes only the read-only [member reflection] member.

members.member: The read-only reflection and dynamic-proxy API. See [FSReflection].
